f3a69cd9-7e31-4e22-839f-911170af5167/Eve.en: "But let us return to the matter on hand...<NL>Ever since <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> was broken,<NL>the only thing that remained in this world was its hilt. The hilt has passed through the hands of many mortal owners over the centuries, yet the sword's blade was nowhere to be found.<NL>Until three hundred years later, when the hilt arrived in the possession of its seventh owner..."

f3a69cd9-7e31-4e22-839f-911170af5167/Opt.en: Passed through the hands of many mortal owners... the hilt arrived in the possession of its seventh owner... Could it be...
f3a69cd9-7e31-4e22-839f-911170af5167/Opt.ru: Прошел через руки многих смертных владельцев... рукоять перешла во владение своего седьмого владельца... Могло ли это быть...

0bed39b1-3565-470c-aca6-cd5d6c15cb8a/Eve.en: "No... Stop... You..."<NL>Within the mournful cry of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color>, Zi Wuxiao suddenly changed her tone and quickly retreated backwards.<NL>Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> could react, everything spun around wildly. Before long, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> abruptly awoke from the dream...

d6a24252-55bb-4811-b1ac-d21b6597b429/Eve.en: "Sindhu, Persia, Tibet...<NL>I never imagined that beyond Cathay, there were so many strange and exotic lands..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> studied the Map of the Western Regions in detail. At that moment, he felt his horizons broadening tremendously<NL>as many marvelous inspirations flowed into his mind...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(You can now build the "Tea-Horse Caravan" in Taiwu Village with this "Core Material"!)</color>

d6a24252-55bb-4811-b1ac-d21b6597b429/Opt.en: Perhaps it would be possible to form a caravan and deploy them to explore the Western Regions with this Map...
d6a24252-55bb-4811-b1ac-d21b6597b429/Opt.ru: Возможно, можно было бы сформировать Караван и направить его исследовать Западные края с помощью этой карты...

4c98a49b-cb8a-4546-a805-e6bab8012e09/Eve.en: Today, dark clouds hung heavy in the sky.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> suddenly heard from outside Taiwu Village a sorrowful wailing.<NL>It seemed that a solitary bamboo stalk of inky blackness had suddenly grown outside of Taiwu Village, which could infect people and livestock in the vicinity with vile illnesses.<NL>Many locals had been harmed by it, yet no one dared approach it...

4c98a49b-cb8a-4546-a805-e6bab8012e09/Opt.en: Such a peculiar bamboo. Perhaps it is related to the Jet-Black Bamboo that Zi Wuxiao spoke of?
4c98a49b-cb8a-4546-a805-e6bab8012e09/Opt.ru: Такой своеобразный бамбук. Возможно, это связано с черным как смоль бамбуком, о котором говорил Цзы Усяо?

66642b5d-cefc-4862-add7-5a8bd1011a70/Eve.en: The fiend's furious growl shook your soul to its core...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was but a mortal who eats only earthly grains, perplexed by myriad of emotions and feelings.<NL>Mortals live in the most fragile vessel that meets its end so easily and has the most fragile, susceptible mind in the world.<NL>Such an inferior creature. How could they not be frightened! How could they not be startled!<NL><NL>Yet...<NL>as the way of heaven declared...<NL>Push a thing too far and it will go the other way...<NL>What was once its weakness will turn around and become its strength...

7f634bb9-1f3e-4af4-9ca7-4c0311b604e9/Eve.en: The demonic blood crashed from the sky like a giant wave!<NL>Amidst the sea of blood, three white lights lifted a rusted and corroded sword blade,<NL>bursting forth from the throat of Xiangshu! It flew straight toward the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color> in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand!<NL>Yet, the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color> trembled violently, as if a mighty foe was near!<NL><NL>"The fiend lies within the sword! Slay the Black Fiend first!"<NL>The old man atop the cliff shouted!

7f634bb9-1f3e-4af4-9ca7-4c0311b604e9/Opt.en: (The fiend lies within the sword! Take on the Black Fiend!)
7f634bb9-1f3e-4af4-9ca7-4c0311b604e9/Opt.ru: (Дьявол скрывается внутри Меча! Сразись с Черным дьяволом!)

254bab29-5c7c-431b-955d-4d2bf538eee7/Eve.en: "The toddler... has no righteous heart. The divine sword... remains no more..."<NL>Tainted muttered with his eyes closed...
254bab29-5c7c-431b-955d-4d2bf538eee7/Eve.ru: - Малыш... у него нет праведного сердца. Божественный Меч... больше не остается..."<NL>- пробормотал Испорченный с закрытыми глазами...

e3c5e54f-0ced-45df-a736-422492db86d4/Eve.en: Immediately right after, Tainted shouted: "Go!"<NL>With his third snarl, his voice blared from the past and resounded into the future!<NL>The Demon-Sealing Light, originally binned into one strong beam, was divided into nine beams once more!<NL>From within the nine Demon-Sealing Lights, the nine divine hilts flew into the sky and restored back to their complete form...

4ef02a28-0c20-4a37-a8d6-85e04ee30832/Eve.en: At first, the world was enveloped in deep silence.<NL>The pure Qi gradually sank downward as the turbid Qi rose upwards.<NL>The clouds dispersed and the mist dimmed. Then, a faint splash of crimson ash, from an unknown origin, silently shrouded the horizon...
4ef02a28-0c20-4a37-a8d6-85e04ee30832/Eve.ru: Сначала мир был окутан глубокой тишиной.<NL>Чистая Ци постепенно опускалась вниз, в то время как мутная Ци поднималась вверх.<NL>Облака рассеялись, и туман рассеялся. Затем слабый всплеск малинового пепла неизвестного происхождения бесшумно окутал горизонт...

2bcf4328-5bea-424c-b1ef-83f7351cf224/Eve.en: "Bizarre or not, it was all but a dream. You're welcome to come here whenever you please..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao whispered quietly, and suddenly a bamboo forest materialized behind her. She then quietly took a seat under the bamboo...
2bcf4328-5bea-424c-b1ef-83f7351cf224/Eve.ru: - Странно это или нет, но все это было всего лишь сном. Вы можете приходить сюда, когда вам заблагорассудится..."<NL>- тихо прошептала Цзы Усяо, и внезапно позади нее материализовался бамбуковый лес. Затем она тихо присела под бамбуком...

2bcf4328-5bea-424c-b1ef-83f7351cf224/Opt.en: ...You said that this was your deep dream, lady. So, could it be that all I saw before were also just dreams?!
2bcf4328-5bea-424c-b1ef-83f7351cf224/Opt.ru: ..Вы сказали, что это была ваша сокровенная мечта, леди. Так, может быть, все, что я видел раньше, тоже было просто сном?!

36b9632a-b092-4311-a268-5879eb071db1/Eve.en: With the sword before his eyes, the Black Fiend revealed itself!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s vision blurred for a moment, and found Huanxin standing next to the cliff with her head down...<NL>How vile Xiangshu was! He had kidnapped Huanxin's Innate Soul! He had stolen Huanxin's powers! He took on Huanxin's form!<NL>He shall die a thousand times!!

36b9632a-b092-4311-a268-5879eb071db1/Opt.en: Thousands of deaths would not be enough for his crimes!!
36b9632a-b092-4311-a268-5879eb071db1/Opt.ru: Тысяч смертей было бы недостаточно для его преступлений!!

0f732f40-a828-4af6-8329-cd60deaf7d73/Eve.en: "Child. I helped you find Huanxin's whereabouts,<NL>and that would be the conclusion of all my promises and karma to that person.<NL>I am... an avatar of an immortal. I wish for nothing but a carefree life, wandering beyond the Three Realms. I do not wish to get tangled in the matter concerning Xiangshu.<NL>You... I wish you luck... and I... will... take my leave now..."

690fc1e4-10d7-48b7-82a7-c8ccb813ce02/Eve.en: "Slaay dem!"<NL>Before her laughter faded, the Western Damsel suddenly turned around, drew the short blade from her waist, and dashed to the bandits who had fallen from their horses.<NL>In the blink of an eye, she had taken the lives of three ruthless bandits...
690fc1e4-10d7-48b7-82a7-c8ccb813ce02/Eve.ru: "Убей их!"<NL>Прежде чем ее смех затих, Западная девица внезапно обернулась, выхватила из-за пояса короткий Клинок и бросилась к бандитам, которые упали со своих лошадей.<NL>В мгновение ока она лишила жизни трех безжалостных бандитов...

05dda879-eb62-47ef-874b-7ed2a50c7843/Eve.en: "Yufu, the wicked bloom. Yes, I remember you clear as day!<NL>Back then... when I was still suffering Nüwa's divine flame at Mt. Chai,<NL>it was you who bloomed in the winter and mesmerized Tainted, leading him to sit entranced before you for three days straight.<NL>It was all thanks to you that Tainted missed the timing to add more fuel to the divine flame, causing the flame to weaken<NL>and allowing me a chance to escape!"

c1c28a2c-1d1e-4a2f-b508-7a3a77e43dbb/Eve.en: "Since it's called the 'Martial World Tournament,'<NL>we, Five Immortals Sect, certainly have the most beautiful skyline, the most potent liquor, and the most abundant insects!"
c1c28a2c-1d1e-4a2f-b508-7a3a77e43dbb/Eve.ru: - Поскольку это называется "Турнир Мира боевых искусств",<NL>у нас, Секты Пяти Бессмертных, безусловно, самый красивый горизонт, самое крепкое Вино и самое большое количество насекомых!"

9ec6f5a3-d012-4ab8-a36b-a2d39dbbe3c1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> yelled, yet felt all strength vanished in an instant.<NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finally woke up from the dream, and their own tears had already soaked through their garment...
9ec6f5a3-d012-4ab8-a36b-a2d39dbbe3c1/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> закричал, но почувствовал, что вся Сила исчезла в одно мгновение.<NL>Когда <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> наконец они очнулись ото сна, и их собственные слезы уже пропитали их одежду насквозь...

b8384002-4a9d-43c6-963e-8e3aeaf93698/Eve.en: Just as the world was about to be destroyed,<NL>a mass of inky black dust dragged a red Qi and a purple Qi out of Xiangshu's skull.<NL>The three that were previously devoured by the black flames<NL>finally seized the chance of the erupting black flames<NL>and escaped!
b8384002-4a9d-43c6-963e-8e3aeaf93698/Eve.ru: Как раз в тот момент, когда мир был близок к уничтожению,<NL>масса чернильно-черной пыли вытащила красную Ци и фиолетовую Ци из черепа Сяншу.<NL>Те трое, которые ранее были поглощены черным пламенем<NL>наконец-то воспользовался шансом извергнуть черное пламя<NL>и сбежал!

b8384002-4a9d-43c6-963e-8e3aeaf93698/Opt.ru: Могло ли это быть... Испорченный даос?

8892566a-15e3-4205-b9cc-75edb5dec548/Eve.en: "Your spiritual light shines bright, so I guess you are probably not going to die easily..."<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> nodded and said, with face pale as a sheet.<NL>Come to think of it, the healing arts for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> must have been conjured for quite some times continuously, which must have exhausted the healer's Qi...

345238ec-e258-4a36-abcf-b05e9f9c3006/Eve.en: "The Martial World Tournament is but merely a gathering of loafers.<NL>However, we of the Vajra Sect have always found delight in sharing life's pleasures together with all walks of life. It would take us no effort at all to preside over this tournament..."
345238ec-e258-4a36-abcf-b05e9f9c3006/Eve.ru: "Турнир Мира боевых искусств - это всего лишь сборище бездельников.<NL>Тем не менее, мы, члены Секты Ваджра, всегда находили удовольствие в том, чтобы делиться жизненными радостями со всеми слоями общества. Нам не потребовалось бы никаких усилий, чтобы возглавить этот турнир..."

e63ef816-f26c-4d80-8fe9-5c09c87d01df/Eve.en: The ancient evil shall be vanquished!

c8c3d992-bfc8-4040-8127-57762987aa68/Eve.en: "Amitabha..."<NL>After a long while, Shishufu let out a Buddhist chant, which woke everyone from their sorrow like a lamp at night.<NL>"Though fiends are now running amok, and the world has faced great destruction, still we are fortunate that the sects have set aside their old grudges to join hands in protecting people across the land.<NL>In such a wonderous moment of unity, I hope that everyone can rouse their spirits and not fall into despair..."

c8c3d992-bfc8-4040-8127-57762987aa68/Opt.en: The sects are all comprised of mortals. How can they stand against so many fiends?
c8c3d992-bfc8-4040-8127-57762987aa68/Opt.ru: Все Секты состоят из смертных. Как они могут противостоять стольким злодеям?

451f070e-5544-4f51-8e13-211c6324aaa3/Eve.en: "The Fuyu Hilt brought you here and led you away... I should have known..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao said softly, still sitting idly under the bamboo. But the bamboo forest behind her was already all in shamble...
451f070e-5544-4f51-8e13-211c6324aaa3/Eve.ru: - Рукоять Фуюй привела тебя сюда и увела прочь... Я должен был догадаться..."<NL>- тихо сказал Цзы Усяо, все еще праздно сидя под бамбуком. Но бамбуковый лес позади нее уже был весь в беспорядке...

451f070e-5544-4f51-8e13-211c6324aaa3/Opt.en: Our previous parting was followed by strange and peculiar circumstances... Now that I see you unharmed and well, you must have prevailed over the black mist, my lady...
451f070e-5544-4f51-8e13-211c6324aaa3/Opt.ru: За нашим предыдущим расставанием последовали странные и своеобразные обстоятельства... Теперь, когда я вижу вас целой и невредимой, вы, должно быть, одержали победу над черным туманом, миледи...

1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Eve.en: "My old friend said... that you are but a mere... mortal. You are... too weak and frail in your skills...<NL>You need to... study... more..."
1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Eve.ru: "Мой старый друг сказал... что ты всего лишь простой... смертный. Ты такой и есть... слишком слаб и хрупок в своих навыках...<NL>Тебе нужно... учиться... больше..."

1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.en: May I know who is this old friend you mentioned earlier?
1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.ru: Могу я узнать, кто этот старый друг, о котором вы упоминали ранее?

1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.en: Did the old friend you mentioned earlier gift the books to me?
1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.ru: Подарил ли мне книги старый друг, о котором вы упоминали ранее?

1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.en: Could you tell me more about the contents of these fourteen books?
1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.ru: Не могли бы вы рассказать мне подробнее о содержании этих четырнадцати книг?

1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.en: I had only heard of people looting valuables, but never expected someone to rob old books as well...
1e7504c5-e71e-4a3b-bad6-67b30cad3ed5/Opt.ru: Я только слышал о людях, грабящих ценные вещи, но никогда не ожидал, что кто-то будет грабить и старые книги...

021cd12c-a75b-4d98-8d6d-329669a8c2bb/Eve.en: "Hm... The time is now<NL>for you to know more about the past..."<NL>Immortal Xu nodded and stoked his "beard" before continuing...
021cd12c-a75b-4d98-8d6d-329669a8c2bb/Eve.ru: - Хм... Время пришло<NL>чтобы ты узнал больше о прошлом..."<NL>Бессмертный Сюй кивнул и взъерошил свою "бороду", прежде чем продолжить...

fb46d4b3-255a-4a9b-a5af-7296d91fdab6/Eve.en: "'I am but a lowly mortal,<NL>unable to move mountains or reclaim the sea...<NL>We are but a single grain of sand in the vast ocean, not worthy of notice...'"
fb46d4b3-255a-4a9b-a5af-7296d91fdab6/Eve.ru: "Я всего лишь простой смертный,<NL>неспособный сдвинуть горы или вернуть себе море...<NL>Мы всего лишь одинокая песчинка в безбрежном океане, не заслуживающая внимания..."

fb46d4b3-255a-4a9b-a5af-7296d91fdab6/Opt.en: What are you saying... Mister Immortal?!
fb46d4b3-255a-4a9b-a5af-7296d91fdab6/Opt.ru: О чем ты говоришь?.. Мистер Бессмертный?!

a7c85c7d-91a5-413e-8f9a-bfd437e67d50/Eve.en: "You are finally awake! Amitabha, the world can now be saved!"<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> nodded and said, with face pale as a sheet.<NL>Come to think of it, the healing arts for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> must have been conjured for quite some times continuously, which must have exhausted the healer's Qi...

3cb3c75f-1ae2-4463-afc0-427c0bb8ee9d/Eve.en: "Dead and nameless..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> chanted in mind...
3cb3c75f-1ae2-4463-afc0-427c0bb8ee9d/Eve.ru: "Мертвый и безымянный..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> повторялось в уме...

341f230a-f6c5-4912-844f-0df0013bfcc0/Eve.en: The cliff was about to collapse and the world was about to crumble!<NL><NL>Immortal Xu stood up from the cliff edge<NL>and glanced at the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color> still shining bright in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand. He lost in his own thought,<NL>and then looked around atop the cliff and shouted...

6f3ffdf2-ba0d-456f-be3c-e33b759a8e31/Eve.en: "So it's probably fine taking on one more sin..."<NL>Immortal Xu said, as his body wasted away and soul shattered.<NL>On this day, he was no more...
6f3ffdf2-ba0d-456f-be3c-e33b759a8e31/Eve.ru: "Так что, наверное, это нормально - взять на себя еще один грех..."<NL>- сказал Бессмертный Сюй, когда его тело истощилось, а душа разбилась вдребезги.<NL>В этот день его больше не было...

40f8327f-e71f-4303-97a8-aa48c3a9e049/Eve.en: "I've told you before. It is my deep dream.<NL>You intruded my dream, and perhaps, you might be able to take a glimpse of my past or two..."
40f8327f-e71f-4303-97a8-aa48c3a9e049/Eve.ru: - Я уже говорил тебе раньше. Это моя сокровенная мечта.<NL>Ты вторгся в мой сон, и, возможно, тебе удастся заглянуть в одно-два моих прошлого..."

40f8327f-e71f-4303-97a8-aa48c3a9e049/Opt.en: I wonder who you really are.
40f8327f-e71f-4303-97a8-aa48c3a9e049/Opt.ru: Интересно, кто ты на самом деле?

cf200a58-306d-4722-bdc8-48854286fea5/Eve.en: As soon as they finished, a strong wind arose and the sword furnace opened...<NL>Between the twelve beams of golden light, a delicate lady transformed into a wisp of Propitious Qi and leaped gracefully into the furnace...
cf200a58-306d-4722-bdc8-48854286fea5/Eve.ru: Как только они закончили, поднялся сильный ветер, и печь для обжига Мечей открылась...<NL>Между двенадцатью лучами золотого света хрупкая леди превратилась в сгусток Благоприятной Ци и грациозно прыгнула в печь...

123084ae-7f5e-4507-8cb7-49333f7b35ff/Eve.en: Today, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was asleep soundly...<NL>and a paper crane folded from a spiritual seal rode the breeze and came before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
123084ae-7f5e-4507-8cb7-49333f7b35ff/Eve.ru: Сегодня, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> он крепко спал...<NL>и бумажный журавлик, сложенный из духовной Печати, пронесся по ветру и появился перед <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

b061493c-fc12-42c5-806e-c4fb4e96866c/Eve.en: "What does the Martial World Tournament have to do with our Kongsang Sect?<NL>Though, if everyone is looking for a place to compete, wouldn't it be most convenient if there were medical kilns and medical halls right nearby..."
b061493c-fc12-42c5-806e-c4fb4e96866c/Eve.ru: "Какое отношение турнир Мира боевых искусств имеет к нашей Секте Кунсан?<NL>Хотя, если все ищут место для соревнований, не было бы удобнее всего, если бы рядом были медицинские печи и медицинские залы..."

e83fdf92-4634-4030-8dd1-1f4f37b2ff30/Eve.en: As Tainted dispersed into thin air...<NL>the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand lost its glow and turned into ashes!
e83fdf92-4634-4030-8dd1-1f4f37b2ff30/Eve.ru: Когда Испорченный растворился в воздухе...<NL>тот <color=#yellow>Меч Фую</color> в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />рука потеряла свое сияние и превратилась в пепел!

0b626b80-8833-47b4-a28f-060bfd7b9bf5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> immediately stood up and leaped to intercept the gray figure's path.<NL>However, the gray figure was unexpectedly fast. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> didn't manage to graze its clothes even with full power.<NL>Yet despite having such superior martial prowess over <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, the gray figure only took evasive actions<NL>and when forced to retaliate, only used not even half of their strength...

dd5ec19b-6278-4d79-93e2-8176afd8e15c/Eve.en: The light of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand faded away, and the sword turned to ashes in an instant!<NL>Huanxin nodded softly to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, and with a gentle smile, she dispersed into thin air...<NL><NL>The black flame incinerated Tainted's Innate Soul completely and could now roam free in the human world, raining atrocities everywhere.<NL>No longer would any land be peaceful in the world,<NL>for all its dwellers are either evils or viles...

dd5ec19b-6278-4d79-93e2-8176afd8e15c/Opt.en: Endless suffering spread across the world with black flame! {0}
dd5ec19b-6278-4d79-93e2-8176afd8e15c/Opt.ru: Бесконечные страдания распространяются по всему миру черным пламенем! {0}

f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Eve.en: "This... Each of... the divine swords has a spirit... of its own... but, because of their damaged... sword blade,<NL>the Purple Bamboo was unable to... give them... a complete form.<NL>So, they looked... like... children themselves..."
f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Eve.ru: - Это... У каждого из... божественных Мечей есть свой Дух... но из-за их поврежденного... Клинка Меча,<NL>Пурпурный Бамбук был не в состоянии этого сделать... дайте им... полную форму.<NL>Итак, они посмотрели... нравится... сами дети..."

f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.en: So, what's so special about the Purple Bamboo?
f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.ru: Итак, что же такого особенного в фиолетовом бамбуке?

f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.en: Why would a Xiangshu Incarnation be born from the divine sword?
f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.ru: Почему воплощение Сяншу должно было родиться от божественного Меча?

f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.en: I seem to have caught sight of a woman in purple...
f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.ru: Кажется, я заметил женщину в фиолетовом...

f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.en: So, this child is the spirit of the divine sword taking form as a bamboo-born avatar...
f1be13c3-40d6-47c3-80d2-0d84dcccf865/Opt.ru: Итак, этот ребенок - Дух божественного Меча, принимающий форму аватара, рожденного из бамбука...

1d8d0eb9-fcb9-47b1-acd2-a9d58d9d2ba8/Eve.en: "Ha, ha, ha! How arrogant!<NL>You have but nine shattered swords, and what of your boasted ten lifetimes of merits?<NL>Where now lies your most beloved <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>? Did you forget it upon Mt. Chai? You've never brought it to this place of your sorrow, didn't you?"<NL>Xiangshu laughed uproariously. He showed no fear of the sealing swords ward, but instead swung his eight arms wide open,<NL>taking Tainted, who was floating in mid-air, into his field of vision...

12918dc0-8d0a-4ba8-8401-13f88b663856/Eve.en: At first, the world was enveloped in deep silence.<NL>The pure Qi gradually sank downward as the turbid Qi rose upwards.<NL>The clouds dispersed and the mist dimmed. Then, a faint splash of crimson ash, from an unknown origin, silently shrouded the horizon...
12918dc0-8d0a-4ba8-8401-13f88b663856/Eve.ru: Сначала мир был окутан глубокой тишиной.<NL>Чистая Ци постепенно опускалась вниз, в то время как мутная Ци поднималась вверх.<NL>Облака рассеялись, и туман рассеялся. Затем слабый всплеск малинового пепла неизвестного происхождения бесшумно окутал горизонт...

bebcfd5b-4f8c-4f89-844a-6bf4b6d38101/Eve.en: However...<NL>The blood ash still lingered in the sky, the blackstones still piled on the ground.<NL>The land remained crumbled, and the sky was still cracked. Of course, the ancient fiend would not perish so easily, would it?!
bebcfd5b-4f8c-4f89-844a-6bf4b6d38101/Eve.ru: Однако...<NL>Кровавый пепел все еще витал в небе, черные камни все еще громоздились на земле.<NL>Земля оставалась раскрошенной, а небо все еще было потрескавшимся. Конечно, древний дьявол не погиб бы так легко, не так ли?!

2ead9edb-26ac-473b-a0a0-0c84058e9528/Eve.en: Only after the white light had risen back into the sky did <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> notice that there was now a person in Tainted's embrace,<NL>who turned out to be the dying Long Yufu...
2ead9edb-26ac-473b-a0a0-0c84058e9528/Eve.ru: Только после того, как белый свет снова поднялся в небо, это произошло <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> обратите внимание, что теперь в объятиях Испорченного был человек,<NL>который оказался умирающим Лонг Юфу...

be27eba5-9a90-46e6-a6b2-91a45657ef8d/Eve.en: "Reality or phantom, it was all but a dream. You're welcome to come here whenever you please..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao whispered quietly, and suddenly a bamboo forest materialized behind her. She then quietly took a seat under the bamboo...
be27eba5-9a90-46e6-a6b2-91a45657ef8d/Eve.ru: - Реальность это или призрак, но все это было всего лишь сном. Вы можете приходить сюда, когда вам заблагорассудится..."<NL>- тихо прошептала Цзы Усяо, и внезапно позади нее материализовался бамбуковый лес. Затем она тихо присела под бамбуком...

be27eba5-9a90-46e6-a6b2-91a45657ef8d/Opt.en: ...You said that this was your deep dream, lady. So, could it be that all I saw before were also just dreams?!
be27eba5-9a90-46e6-a6b2-91a45657ef8d/Opt.ru: ..Вы сказали, что это была ваша сокровенная мечта, леди. Так, может быть, все, что я видел раньше, тоже было просто сном?!

b1c084ea-0335-4219-a58c-d38c7e8a76ba/Eve.en: "So... be it...<NL>I have... a thing here... that I can gift you...<NL>to make up... for my failure to keep... my promise... with my old friend,<NL>losing... that fourteen... old books. Here... reach out... with your hands..."<NL>Tainted said slowly with his hands behind his back, giving no indication that he held anything to present to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

b1c084ea-0335-4219-a58c-d38c7e8a76ba/Opt.en: (Reach out with hands) Are you jesting with me again, Mister Taoist... Are you trying that old trick again...
b1c084ea-0335-4219-a58c-d38c7e8a76ba/Opt.ru: (Протягиваю руки) Вы снова шутите надо мной, господин даос... Ты снова пробуешь этот старый трюк?..

c0d67367-8603-4347-a594-adc25aa6b08f/Eve.ru: - Ха-ха-ха! Очевидно! Это было так очевидно!"

dc30b965-035c-44d0-8766-faad9f117da1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> thought over it carefully,<NL>and had talks with <ArgBox key=SectName type=string/>'s disciples, sharing with them all the adventures and experiences in the past.<NL><ArgBox key=SectName type=string/>'s disciples learned them all by heart and found enlightenment. They then bowed deeply to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> before taking their leave...

6f34dfc0-4082-44af-b89a-4b118a9ba6d0/Eve.en: "Oh no! What's happening in the East Sea!?<NL>Why am I here staring at her for three whole days? Why did I forgo my duty of guarding the divine furnace!"<NL>The gale swept away the last wisp of black flame, seemingly going to subside, but the sounds from within the gale gradually became sorrowful,<NL>and a lone figure slowly walked out from within...

f3ca5ccc-bf48-4e09-adef-85c5f424fd40/Eve.en: "You are... Taiwu..."<NL>The Oddity nodded, as if he did not hear <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s response...
f3ca5ccc-bf48-4e09-adef-85c5f424fd40/Eve.ru: - Так и есть... Тайу..."<NL>Чудак кивнул, как будто не слышал <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />это ответ...

f3ca5ccc-bf48-4e09-adef-85c5f424fd40/Opt.en: Who are you? How may I address you?
f3ca5ccc-bf48-4e09-adef-85c5f424fd40/Opt.ru: Кто ты такой? Как я могу к вам обращаться?

5682ee73-0571-4135-b0f7-54c45c4a699e/Eve.en: "... Thanks... to you...<NL>...for rescuing us from... the black flames..."<NL><NL>Tainted cast a brief glance at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>then raised his arms to deliver the purple and red pure Qi from the black flames.<NL>The two pure Qi flew over to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s back, and took the forms of Long Yufu and Zi Wuxiao, respectively.<NL>Though the two of them were unconscious, evidently they had suffered considerable injury from the black flames...

5682ee73-0571-4135-b0f7-54c45c4a699e/Opt.en: The black flames are very dangerous! Come out quickly, Mister Taoist!
5682ee73-0571-4135-b0f7-54c45c4a699e/Opt.ru: Черное пламя очень опасно! Выходите скорее, господин даос!

064a3a47-273e-4d44-8a27-6771b3f09e45/Eve.en: Tainted continued to conjure his immortal power,<NL>and the nine divine lights wove together, forming a dome of sealing swords ward that descended upon Taiwu Village!<NL><NL>Yet, despite the mighty power of the sealing swords ward, the fiend would never stand down so easily!<NL>The fiend kicked blood and ash into the air, spreading an enveloping black mist over the sky.<NL>He then inverted the blackstone, revealing the mountains of corpses and the sea of blood from beneath the earth...

a906a798-8a95-4001-aaa9-d0d0547458c6/Eve.en: "... Immortal Xu... Please forgive me...<NL>The blacksmith was a good man. He was kind, caring and just. He should not have died amidst the war...<NL>Wouldn't it be much better if your panacea could save his life instead of that cruel king, whose savage legacy may then extend beyond thousands of years?"<NL><NL>A woman's voice followed, her voice soft like flowing water...

9537a796-5c9a-43a1-8839-5963dbaa8a4d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> closed the eyes,<NL>yet could see clearly in the mind:<NL><NL>There, where fiends ran rampant,<NL>men, women, elders and children fought with their mortal bodies and arts in desperation...<NL>In another place, amidst the mountains of corpses and seas of blood, enemies fought shoulder to shoulder and lovers died hand in hand.<NL>Yet, there, deep in the profound darkness, were those glints of firelight? Amidst the enchanting tones in and out, growling is everywhere!<NL><NL>Upon the blood ashes, seeds thrived to take root...<NL>Under the blackstones, fragrant grass was about to sprout...

6e65e897-7680-4428-8345-0a9069f2ddf2/Eve.en: "The young... had their ambition depleted, and the divine sword... lamented alone..."<NL>Tainted muttered with his eyes closed...
6e65e897-7680-4428-8345-0a9069f2ddf2/Eve.ru: - Молодые... их амбиции были исчерпаны, и божественный Меч... оплакивался в одиночестве..."<NL>- пробормотал Испорченный с закрытыми глазами...

c188ac89-aafe-4c69-a10f-fa0fd3d5c933/Eve.en: "Immortality itself defies the law of the heaven.<NL>To do evil and survive, it will surely beckon the heaven's wrath.<NL>Right now, I have taken your earnest account of pleading for the panacea and will fault you no more.<NL>However, I shall split this panacea into two, and you may extend the Purple Bamboo's life with the first half, and save a kind and just mortal with the second..."<NL>Tainted spoke aloud, conjuring a white light with a wave of hands. Then, he divided the immortality panacea in Immortal Xu's hand into two,<NL>letting Zi Wuxiao take the first half right away. Then he handed her the second half and asked her to save someone with it...

df1535ac-69b0-47dd-8263-1c5ab0883d30/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> defeated the Black Fiend, who was born from Huanxin's Innate Soul after the corruption of Xiangshu!
df1535ac-69b0-47dd-8263-1c5ab0883d30/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> победил Черного Дьявола, который родился из Врожденной души Хуаньсинь после порчи Сяншу!

ab305e8c-2dc9-432a-86b9-22c89a7e4935/Eve.en: "..."<NL>Tainted cast Long Yufu a deep look, and then cast Zi Wuxiao another deep look...<NL>Tainted had already taken in all black flames that lingered on Xiangshu's remains into his body...
ab305e8c-2dc9-432a-86b9-22c89a7e4935/Eve.ru: "..."<NL>Испорченный бросил на Лонг Юфу глубокий взгляд, а затем бросил на Цзы Усяо еще один глубокий взгляд...<NL>Испорченный уже вобрал в себя все черное пламя, которое оставалось на останках Сяншу, в его тело...

f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Eve.en: "The... Purple Bamboo..."<NL>Tainted said slowly, looking as if his thought had wandered more far away with each word spoken.<NL>"The Purple Bamboo... and the blackstone... can coexist with each other... or exterminate each other.<NL>One lives... the other dies..."
f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Eve.ru: - Тот самый... Фиолетовый бамбук..."<NL>- медленно произнес Испорченный, выглядя так, словно с каждым произнесенным словом его мысли забредали все дальше.<NL>- Пурпурный бамбук... и черный камень... могут сосуществовать друг с другом... или истребят друг друга.<NL>Один живет... другой умирает..."

f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.en: So, what's so special about the Purple Bamboo?
f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.ru: Итак, что же такого особенного в фиолетовом бамбуке?

f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.en: Why would a Xiangshu Incarnation be born from the divine sword?
f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.ru: Почему воплощение Сяншу должно было родиться от божественного Меча?

f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.en: I seem to have caught sight of a woman in purple...
f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.ru: Кажется, я заметил женщину в фиолетовом...

f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.en: So, this child is the spirit of the divine sword taking form as a bamboo-born avatar...
f52c93e3-7e1a-4d37-b54c-43d578e8a84c/Opt.ru: Итак, этот ребенок - Дух божественного Меча, принимающий форму аватара, рожденного из бамбука...

e6167f64-a8b9-4732-8d3f-a79fbd7409d6/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was about to step forward to help,<NL>the Fuyu Hilt in hand suddenly gleamed brilliantly.<NL>For a moment, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> saw only a radiant glow and nothing else, and found themselves awoken from the dream after opening the eyes again...
e6167f64-a8b9-4732-8d3f-a79fbd7409d6/Eve.ru: Как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> собирался шагнуть вперед, чтобы помочь,<NL>Рукоять Фуюй в руке внезапно ослепительно сверкнула.<NL>На мгновение, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> увидели только сияющее сияние и ничего больше, и обнаружили, что очнулись ото сна после того, как снова открыли глаза...

ea53fc7d-7b73-4fc5-8c5e-12b725384219/Eve.en: "O' brilliant Black Immortal..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> continued to chant...
ea53fc7d-7b73-4fc5-8c5e-12b725384219/Eve.ru: "О, блестящий черный Бессмертный..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> продолжал петь...

31a241e1-23a6-428d-98d1-78db384b39ed/Eve.en: "A thousand years ago, beyond the East Sea...<NL>there was once an unrivaled divine sword that had once defeated and imprisoned Xiangshu.<NL>Due to an unexpected awakening of its spirit, it flew into the mortal world on its own accord..."
31a241e1-23a6-428d-98d1-78db384b39ed/Eve.ru: - Тысячу лет назад, за Восточным морем...<NL>когда-то существовал непревзойденный божественный Меч, который однажды победил Сяншу и заключил его в тюрьму.<NL>Из-за неожиданного пробуждения своего Духа он по собственной воле прилетел в мир смертных..."

d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Eve.en: "I brought... a few old books... from my home in Mt. Chai... that I wish to gift to you..."<NL>Tainted finished and kept his hands behind his back, giving no indication that he held anything to present to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>After a long while, there was still no further action from Tainted. Overwhelmed by the awkwardness, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> had no choice but to ask him...

d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.en: Mister Taoist... If you have something to say, you might as well say it!
d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.ru: Господин даос... Если вам есть что сказать, вы могли бы с таким же успехом это сказать!

d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.en: You've come from afar, Mister Taoist, and for that, I am already deeply grateful. With the gift of books, I would certainly bow in thanks for your generosity...
d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.ru: Вы пришли издалека, господин даос, и я уже глубоко благодарен вам за это. Подарив книги, я, конечно, поклонился бы в знак благодарности за вашу щедрость...

d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.en: You and I have never met, and you are clearly a man of few words, Mister Taoist. So, I'm afraid I don't deserve such generosity...
d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.ru: Мы с вами никогда не встречались, и вы явно немногословный человек, господин даос. Так что, боюсь, я не заслуживаю такой щедрости...

d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.en: Are you trying to get me to plead for the books?
d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.ru: Ты пытаешься заставить меня вступиться за книги?

d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.en: You are deliberately vague in your words, Mister Taoist. Are you really here to gift us books, or are you trying to get something from us instead?
d51e462e-f845-4825-a069-f98ff10eccad/Opt.ru: Вы намеренно расплывчаты в своих словах, господин даос. Вы действительно здесь для того, чтобы подарить нам книги, или вместо этого пытаетесь что-то получить от нас?

435c193c-e274-4670-a2cc-0516815e12f7/Eve.en: "This is bad...<NL>The fiend still managed to find me... You... Go now..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao said while picking up the bamboo pieces on the ground quickly.<NL>Then, she conjured a few Propitious Qi from the bamboo and surrounded the black mist with them...
435c193c-e274-4670-a2cc-0516815e12f7/Eve.ru: "Это плохо...<NL>Дьяволу все же удалось найти меня... Ты... А теперь иди..."<NL>- сказал Цзы Усяо, быстро подбирая с земли кусочки бамбука.<NL>Затем она наколдовала несколько благоприятных Ци из бамбука и окружила ими черный туман...

f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Eve.en: "All mortals... have things... that they are obsessed with...<NL>You... have done what mortals... cannot do and stirred thoughts... that mortals should not stir. I wonder... what you after?"<NL>Tainted turned around, asking a question that he had been long pondering...
f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Eve.ru: - Все смертные... есть вещи... этим они одержимы...<NL>Ты... сделал то, чего не могут сделать смертные... и всколыхнул мысли... что смертные не должны шевелиться. Интересно... чего ты добиваешься?"<NL>Испорченный обернулся, задавая вопрос, над которым он долго размышлял...

f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.en: I aid those who suffer from injustice. I have the power to vanquish the fiends, and I cannot stand idly by when someone is in need...
f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.ru: Я помогаю тем, кто страдает от несправедливости. У меня есть сила победить демонов, и я не могу бездействовать, когда кто-то в этом нуждается...

f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.en: I carried great responsibilities on my shoulders and high expectations upon me. Many lives are innocent in this, and so I must strive to do all I can...
f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.ru: На моих плечах лежала огромная ответственность, и на меня возлагались большие надежды. Многие жизни невиновны в этом, и поэтому я должен стремиться сделать все, что в моих силах...

f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.en: Everything in the world follows the cycle of karma. What I do today must already be destined by fate...
f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.ru: Все в мире подчиняется циклу кармы. То, что я делаю сегодня, должно быть, уже предопределено судьбой...

f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.en: While others live a mundane life, I shall live my life more grandiose than ever...
f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.ru: В то время как другие живут обыденной жизнью, я проживу свою жизнь более грандиозно, чем когда-либо...

f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.en: Those who achieve great deeds will naturally stand out and be admired by the masses, for they shall walk unmatched paths and leave lasting marks in this world...
f13478db-bd8f-4e57-9391-803b536113d5/Opt.ru: Те, кто совершает великие деяния, естественно, будут выделяться и вызывать восхищение масс, ибо они пройдут непревзойденными путями и оставят неизгладимый след в этом мире...

b0ca29e2-c775-408d-a133-999725051eb5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> thought over it carefully,<NL>and found nothing in bag that could be of use for <ArgBox key=SectName type=string/> in preparing the Martial World Tournament...<NL><ArgBox key=SectName type=string/>'s disciples were greatly disappointed and left resentfully, shaking their heads and sighing in defeat...

b0ca29e2-c775-408d-a133-999725051eb5/Opt.en: (Guess that's how it has to be...)

eabe34f8-b5bc-49b1-bc0d-a3fd22d8c10a/Eve.en: "Xiangshu... was burned... by the divine flame... for billions of years...<NL>The divine flame... was also corrupted by him... giving birth to the black flame, which is the source... of his fiendish nature. It... cannot be... destroyed... unless..."<NL>Tainted said, slowly putting his hand on Xiangshu's charred forehead<NL>and allowing the black flame to crawl over his arm...

d02aeb38-eb83-410c-abe9-2d118ae67667/Eve.en: "You are awake, finally. There's no need to thank us.<NL>It was just hard on our sect members because we haven't had a chance to clean up ourselves in the past seven days..."<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> sighed, eyes filled with blood vessels and sweat still damp on forehead...

d02aeb38-eb83-410c-abe9-2d118ae67667/Opt.en: So... you all have been waiting here... for seven days...
d02aeb38-eb83-410c-abe9-2d118ae67667/Opt.ru: Итак... вы все ждали здесь... в течение семи дней...

a9e1b7c9-c7bf-4972-b1de-136c678177fc/Eve.en: "I'm sorry,<NL>but Lady is urging me to bring her back to the caravan...<NL>This is a gift from my Lady as a token of her gratitude for your assistance. Please accept it!"
a9e1b7c9-c7bf-4972-b1de-136c678177fc/Eve.ru: "Мне очень жаль,<NL>но леди уговаривает меня вернуть ее в Караван...<NL>Это подарок от миледи в знак ее благодарности за вашу помощь. Пожалуйста, прими это!"

f9b6ecba-189b-4ff5-9bd8-575e86713840/Eve.en: "Ha! Ha! Ha!<NL>Yet, the most pitiable one is still you!"<NL>Xiangshu laughed at Zi Wuxiao, who was standing behind Tainted:<NL><NL>"You are selfishness, you are a fiend, and you are too low to be 'used.'<NL>It's a shame that you forged the sword with your martyrdom and willingly surrendered yourself to eternal nothingness! I have witnessed all the sufferings and ugliness in all the worlds,<NL>yet I've never seen anyone like you who sacrifices himself for hate..."<NL><NL>Tainted's heart ached with pain...

3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Eve.en: "You... saw... her?!<NL>I... reckon... it must be... due to the inner connectio...n between Fuyu... and her..."<NL>Tainted muttered, evidently at a loss. He suddenly closed his eyes and said no more words, seemingly thought of something...
3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Eve.ru: - Ты... видел... ее?!<NL>Я... полагаю... так и должно быть... из-за внутренней связи между Фую... и ней..."<NL>- пробормотал Испорченный, явно пребывая в растерянности. Он вдруг закрыл глаза и больше не произнес ни слова, казалось, о чем-то задумался...

3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.en: So, what's so special about the Purple Bamboo?
3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.ru: Итак, что же такого особенного в фиолетовом бамбуке?

3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.en: Why would a Xiangshu Incarnation be born from the divine sword?
3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.ru: Почему воплощение Сяншу должно было родиться от божественного Меча?

3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.en: I seem to have caught sight of a woman in purple...
3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.ru: Кажется, я заметил женщину в фиолетовом...

3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.en: So, this child is the spirit of the divine sword taking form as a bamboo-born avatar...
3a9cd277-2b6e-4a25-b0ff-da73bbddca07/Opt.ru: Итак, этот ребенок - Дух божественного Меча, принимающий форму аватара, рожденного из бамбука...

3e0f22fe-abea-40ab-8b3e-993211cc6276/Eve.en: "While we of the Fuloong Sanctuary are the place where the True Loong takes rest,<NL>if the people in the world could all pledge their allegiance to our master, the True Loong. There could be some worth to convene this Martial World Tournament..."
3e0f22fe-abea-40ab-8b3e-993211cc6276/Eve.ru: "В то время как мы, Святилище усмиряющих драконов, являемся местом, где отдыхает истинный Лун,<NL>если бы все люди в мире могли присягнуть на верность нашему учителю, Истинному Лун. Возможно, было бы что-то стоящее в том, чтобы созвать этот турнир Мира боевых искусств..."

69d549e2-1352-4a92-b55e-b2fb830c4fa7/Eve.en: Before one realizes...<NL>a drop of clarity quietly entered <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind, clearing the haze that clouded the mind,<NL>as gentle as spring breeze melting away the ice, and as tender as the autumn wind sweeping away the fallen leaves!<NL>Suddenly, the world opened up wide! The towering trees grew, reaching the heaven. The blossoming flowers flourished in blooming profusion! Unknown trees and never-seen-before blooms are everywhere...<NL><NL>Before any could realize, the heaven and earth blended together as one, and everything turned hazy and surreal...

69d549e2-1352-4a92-b55e-b2fb830c4fa7/Opt.en: Dead and nameless. Dazed and shapeless...
69d549e2-1352-4a92-b55e-b2fb830c4fa7/Opt.ru: Мертвый и безымянный. Ошеломленный и бесформенный...

4e1df35d-5cbf-489b-80af-fe50c48f0953/Eve.en: In this instant, everything changed rapidly!<NL>When Tainted finally put <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> back down, the two of them had already landed atop a small mountain...
4e1df35d-5cbf-489b-80af-fe50c48f0953/Eve.ru: В это мгновение все стремительно изменилось!<NL>Когда испорченный окончательно положат <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> спустившись обратно, они вдвоем уже приземлились на вершине небольшой горы...

4e1df35d-5cbf-489b-80af-fe50c48f0953/Opt.en: ... Mister Taoist... What in the world... happened?!
4e1df35d-5cbf-489b-80af-fe50c48f0953/Opt.ru: .. Мистер даос... Что за чертовщина... случилось?!

03354a99-bd69-4804-aefd-3aa4378f74db/Eve.en: Today,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> thought of the last two Sword Mounds that remained tightly closed and couldn't help but worry about it.<NL>While pondering, they could not help but take out the Fuyu Sword Forge and Immortal Xu's Remains and examined them...<NL>The Fuyu Sword Forge was the crux of the Sword Mound Array, and Immortal Xu seemed to have a connection to the Sword Mound Array too.<NL>Perhaps he was the pivot of the Sword Mound Array?

03354a99-bd69-4804-aefd-3aa4378f74db/Opt.en: The way to open the last two Sword Mounds may rest with 'you'...
03354a99-bd69-4804-aefd-3aa4378f74db/Opt.ru: Способ открыть последние два Кургана мечей может зависеть от "вас"...

f196c48e-bfac-468b-85bf-b7e435ae2acf/Eve.en: Behold—<NL>Here was the Monu Weave, its spiritual light soft as water.<NL>Here was the Spiritsealer, unbroken despite countless fights!<NL>There was the Dark Frost, lucid and translucent with frigid gleam.<NL>There was the Fenghuang Cocoon, its golden radiance brighter than the golden sun!<NL>Under the divine glow, there was the Ignideus Blaze, its fires blazing brightly in different lives and shining with radiant beauty.<NL>Tracing the divine light, there was the Candelor's Tail, balanced yet unyielding and remained ever-varying.<NL>In the shadow under the haze, there was the Vitalos, shifting between real and phantom at will.<NL>Amid the raging clouds and turbulent winds, there was the Demonbind, unrivaled in the past and present.<NL>Where the sun and moon communes and the stars fall, where the sky was clear and unobstructed, there was the Rainbow Ultima, unmatched in Yin and Yang and unparalleled in the cosmos!

6ae3b312-15ba-421a-855d-5cd2d2326d71/Eve.en: "..."<NL>Tainted cast Long Yufu a deep look, and then cast Zi Wuxiao another deep look...<NL>Tainted had already taken in all black flames that lingered on Xiangshu's remains into his body...
6ae3b312-15ba-421a-855d-5cd2d2326d71/Eve.ru: "..."<NL>Испорченный бросил на Лонг Юфу глубокий взгляд, а затем бросил на Цзы Усяо еще один глубокий взгляд...<NL>Испорченный уже вобрал в себя все черное пламя, которое оставалось на останках Сяншу, в его тело...

452e67a4-f6da-4d08-ae8e-f2ea038e1539/Eve.en: "The <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>... is born with a spirit.<NL>Yet with strong empathy comes the bitterness of love... if left unattended, it would... become a fiend... Even if it... was not shattered by you...<NL>I would... have my disciples... break it as soon as possible... to prevent unleashing another evil upon the world!<NL>I would never have it... used... in vanquishing fiends!"<NL><NL>Although Tainted spoke with determination,<NL>his eyes betrayed his deep reluctance and sorrow...

d66412f3-357e-4ab4-bc29-707c391f1114/Eve.en: Today, a group of dusty travelers came to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s whereabouts.<NL>It turned out, <ArgBox key=SectName type=string/>'s disciples came to seek help in preparing for the Martial World Tournament...
d66412f3-357e-4ab4-bc29-707c391f1114/Eve.ru: Сегодня группа запыленных путешественников приехала в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />его местонахождение.<NL>Оказалось, <ArgBox key=SectName type=string/>Ученики пришли за помощью в подготовке к турниру Мира боевых искусств...

6e0ba44c-e3af-430a-a2f4-bccfff2b24ec/Eve.en: "It's me! It's me who released the fiend!"<NL>Tainted yelled, gritting his teeth as if he was torn at his heart. He emerged from the gale with wounds all over his body!
6e0ba44c-e3af-430a-a2f4-bccfff2b24ec/Eve.ru: - Это я! Это я освободил дьявола!"<NL>Испорченный закричал, стиснув зубы, как будто у него разрывалось сердце. Он выбрался из шторма с ранами по всему телу!

176ba1bc-fde3-4016-8cc9-2fcc552b2268/Eve.en: "You've repeatedly barged into my deep dream. Hehe. Perhaps you are fated to help me escape..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao walked closer to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and said with a smile on her face...
176ba1bc-fde3-4016-8cc9-2fcc552b2268/Eve.ru: - Ты неоднократно врывался в мой глубокий сон. Хе-хе. Возможно, тебе суждено помочь мне сбежать..."<NL>Цзы Усяо подошел ближе к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> и сказала с улыбкой на лице...

2a19a33b-d573-40bc-a088-5e63806f6185/Eve.en: As the blood entered the fiend's body, divine light manifested posthaste!<NL>The three streams of blood within Xiangshu immediately formed three pure phantom swords!<NL>The white swords wreaked havoc in Xiangshu's stomach fiercely, and charged straight for his throat!
2a19a33b-d573-40bc-a088-5e63806f6185/Eve.ru: Когда кровь вошла в тело демона, божественный свет проявился мгновенно!<NL>Три потока крови внутри Сяншу немедленно образовали три чистых призрачных Меча!<NL>Белые Мечи яростно посеяли хаос в животе Сяншу и устремились прямо к его горлу!

2a19a33b-d573-40bc-a088-5e63806f6185/Opt.en: The phantom swords... They are going after the sword blade of the "Fuyu Sword"!
2a19a33b-d573-40bc-a088-5e63806f6185/Opt.ru: Призрачные Мечи... Они охотятся за Клинком Меча "Меч Фую"!

5571c228-930b-4eda-8955-db775abe2a4d/Eve.en: "I know not what or who you have seen previously.<NL>However, dreams are limited by the knowledge of the dreaming person, and thus, it is difficult to see the truth within a dream.<NL>If you do not mind the solitude of this place, you are certainly welcomed to have a chat with me..."
5571c228-930b-4eda-8955-db775abe2a4d/Eve.ru: "Я не знаю, что или кого вы видели раньше.<NL>Однако сны ограничены знаниями спящего человека, и, таким образом, трудно увидеть истину во сне.<NL>Если вы не возражаете против уединения этого места, я, конечно, приглашаю вас поболтать со мной..."

5571c228-930b-4eda-8955-db775abe2a4d/Opt.en: "Dreams are limited by the knowledge of the dreaming person, and thus, it is difficult to see the truth within a dream"...
5571c228-930b-4eda-8955-db775abe2a4d/Opt.ru: "Сны ограничены знаниями спящего человека, и, таким образом, трудно увидеть истину во сне"...

e514904b-48d0-4776-9bc4-c94412c3fea6/Eve.en: "And so, the world trembled and the axiom shattered.<NL>The child returned to its true form as the divine sword, and continued its fateful battle with Xiangshu, until..."
e514904b-48d0-4776-9bc4-c94412c3fea6/Eve.ru: "Итак, мир содрогнулся, и аксиома разлетелась вдребезги.<NL>Ребенок вернулся к своему истинному облику божественного Меча и продолжил свою судьбоносную битву с Сяншу, пока..."

e514904b-48d0-4776-9bc4-c94412c3fea6/Opt.en: Until... Xiangshu was imprisoned... and the swords shattered and their spirits perished...
e514904b-48d0-4776-9bc4-c94412c3fea6/Opt.ru: Пока... Сяншу был заключен в тюрьму... и Мечи разбились вдребезги, а их души погибли...

76a13771-45cc-4fd3-8b6e-fe3446c01a68/Eve.en: "A five years old... mischievous child... from the... next village<NL>took... my book carriage... and threw it... into the river. I tried to look for it for three days... but to no avail..."<NL>Tainted frowned and said. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> wouldn't have imagined, the 'evildoer' he said who snatched the books actually turned out to be a mischievous child from the neighboring village.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> knew most of the folk around here, and there was certainly no one particularly unusual.<NL>It seemed that the 'evildoer' Tainted referred to was truly just a five-year-old child...

6e1663cf-c66e-4c8b-ad1b-1937b25758dc/Eve.en: "Do you... have... any wish... unfulfilled..."<NL>Tainted's voice suddenly came from above <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s head,<NL>sounding as if right by the ear, but Tainted remained still high above the nine heavens...
6e1663cf-c66e-4c8b-ad1b-1937b25758dc/Eve.ru: "У тебя... есть... любое желание... неисполненное..."<NL>Внезапно сверху донесся голос Испорченного <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />голова человека,<NL>звучало как будто прямо у уха, но Испорченный по-прежнему оставался высоко над девятью небесами...

6e1663cf-c66e-4c8b-ad1b-1937b25758dc/Opt.en: Why do you ask, Mister Taoist?

73a87440-1fb1-48ce-9e56-0bd9fa909d09/Eve.en: "You!"<NL>Long Yufu turned around suddenly and bellowed at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
73a87440-1fb1-48ce-9e56-0bd9fa909d09/Eve.ru: "Ты!"<NL>Лун Юфу внезапно обернулся и проревел на <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!

981c4e40-4c3b-4961-8f5c-778397c77dfc/Eve.en: "Good!<NL>Right now, despite the countless relics and expositions of dharma in the world,<NL>the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> is the sole key to vanquish Xiangshu and stop this millennial calamity!<NL><NL>If the Fuyu Sword is not reforged...<NL>there will be no peace to this world, and the fiend shall never be vanquished!"

981c4e40-4c3b-4961-8f5c-778397c77dfc/Opt.en: I fully concur with what you said, Mister Immortal. But I do not know... how can we reforge the "Fuyu Sword"!?
981c4e40-4c3b-4961-8f5c-778397c77dfc/Opt.ru: Я полностью согласен с тем, что вы сказали, мистер Бессмертный. Но я не знаю... как мы можем перековать "Меч Фую"!?

2fa4029a-233c-4b03-9602-645fe35ed550/Eve.en: "So... be it...<NL>I do not wish to... see 'her'... re-emerge... and suffer... further...<NL>Perhaps... stopping it... here would be the best... ending..."<NL>Tainted let out a soft sigh, sounding mixed with emotions,<NL>with sorrow and joy...<NL>with acceptance and bitterness...
2fa4029a-233c-4b03-9602-645fe35ed550/Eve.ru: - Так... пусть будет так...<NL>Я не хочу... видеть "ее"... возродиться... и страдать... дальше...<NL>Возможно... остановить это... здесь было бы лучшим... концом..."<NL>Испорченный издал тихий вздох, в котором звучали смешанные эмоции,<NL>с печалью и радостью...<NL>с приятием и горечью...

2fa4029a-233c-4b03-9602-645fe35ed550/Opt.en: Mister Taoist seemed extremely perplexed about opening or closing of this Sword Mound for reason unknown...
2fa4029a-233c-4b03-9602-645fe35ed550/Opt.ru: Господин Даос, казалось, был крайне озадачен открытием или закрытием этого Кургана мечей по неизвестной причине...

ff5977b9-49fe-4b77-84e9-7b8409840ada/Eve.en: Lost in thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> then examined the Sword Mounds once more.<NL>The three Sword Mounds had all faded in color and remained firmly shut. Not the faintest stir could be seen or heard from any of them at this moment...
ff5977b9-49fe-4b77-84e9-7b8409840ada/Eve.ru: Погруженный в свои мысли, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> затем еще раз осмотрел курганы с Мечами.<NL>Все три кургана с Мечами выцвели по цвету и оставались плотно закрытыми. Ни от кого из них в этот момент не было видно и не слышно ни малейшего шевеления...

ff5977b9-49fe-4b77-84e9-7b8409840ada/Opt.en: Where things go awry, misfortune is sure to follow... The Sword Mounds lay in silence, as still as dead ashes, yet now we could not disturb them in even the slightest way...
ff5977b9-49fe-4b77-84e9-7b8409840ada/Opt.ru: Там, где все идет наперекосяк, обязательно последует несчастье... Курганы мечей лежали в тишине, неподвижные, как мертвый пепел, но теперь мы не могли потревожить их ни малейшим образом...

f9e5914a-db9d-470f-9d74-de38505d8e7d/Eve.en: Tainted stood still for a moment,<NL>eventually slowly closing his eyes.<NL>Then, he drifted toward the two ladies like a feather dampened by rain,<NL>and cast themselves together into the black flame...
f9e5914a-db9d-470f-9d74-de38505d8e7d/Eve.ru: Испорченный на мгновение застыл на месте,<NL>в конце концов он медленно закрыл глаза.<NL>Затем он поплыл к двум дамам, как перышко, намоченное дождем,<NL>и вместе бросились в черное пламя...

651e2d30-ec7e-4809-b212-dd7567df05cf/Eve.en: "'Pertaining to what is named as 'Taiwu'...<NL>When one passes away, another of the family steps up to carry on the duty...<NL>Overcoming all obstacles with successors taking the place of predecessors...'"
651e2d30-ec7e-4809-b212-dd7567df05cf/Eve.ru: "Относящийся к тому, что называется "Тайу"...<NL>Когда один из них умирает, другой член семьи вступает в должность, чтобы выполнить этот долг...<NL>Преодолевая все препятствия, преемники занимают место предшественников..."

651e2d30-ec7e-4809-b212-dd7567df05cf/Opt.en: What are you saying... Mister Immortal?!
651e2d30-ec7e-4809-b212-dd7567df05cf/Opt.ru: О чем ты говоришь?.. Мистер Бессмертный?!

ecc8239b-9ac6-457b-b122-129a14912184/Eve.en: Today, when <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> returned to Taiwu Village,<NL>several letters bearing the words "Invitation Letter" and originating from various sects<NL>almost arrived in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hands at the same time...
ecc8239b-9ac6-457b-b122-129a14912184/Eve.ru: Сегодня, когда <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> вернулся в Деревню Тайу,<NL>несколько писем со словами "Письмо-приглашение", исходящих от различных сект<NL>почти прибыл в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />его руки одновременно...

c51cc249-7951-4594-8463-50eb279ff197/Eve.en: "Go... again..."<NL>Tainted helped <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> up,<NL>and with another sudden swing of his hand, he sent <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> to the blossom sea with a breeze...
c51cc249-7951-4594-8463-50eb279ff197/Eve.ru: "Давай... еще раз..."<NL>Испорченный помог <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> вверх,<NL>и еще одним резким взмахом руки он послал <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> к цветущему морю с легким ветерком...

0a66906b-ccd3-4735-a697-c0768ba49830/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was startled and alerted. Perhaps it was because of the connection with the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color> that displayed some strange phenomenon just now,<NL>while still unclear as to what exactly had occurred, they could sense that this was no trivial matter:<NL>something major must have happened inside the Sword Mound "{0}"...

3106d076-b0ea-490c-88af-1e5cfc4ab844/Eve.en: After a long while...<NL>The storm calmed and the sky was clear again.<NL>Tainted dispersed into thin air...<NL>The <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand lost its glow and turned to ashes!
3106d076-b0ea-490c-88af-1e5cfc4ab844/Eve.ru: Спустя долгое время...<NL>Буря утихла, и небо снова стало ясным.<NL>Испорченный растворился в воздухе...<NL>Тот <color=#yellow>Меч Фую</color> в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />рука потеряла свое сияние и превратилась в пепел!

6ef9ede9-c15c-40d5-9017-62bab0ff4724/Eve.en: "All right!<NL>I will now find a suitable location to prepare the Rising Perception spell,<NL>which should help you reach the Land of Blackstones and retrieve the sword blade of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>!"<NL>Immortal Xu nodded, who then divined the future with a single gesture and made a promise with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />:<NL>After Immortal Xu has found a suitable location to prepare for the Rising Perception spell, he will signal to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> with fire.<NL>However, the Rising Perception spell requires both the right time and the right place.<NL>Therefore, if one misses the opportunity, then another place must be located for the spell...

a4450538-146f-43d2-9e56-2ad83998faa7/Eve.en: "Don't be alarmed, Immortal Xu.<NL>It was true that the previous Eight Swords Array imprisoned you as its pivot and cost you three hundred years of freedom.<NL>While I am not certain what risks lie in the last array, it was likely due to the insufficient power of the array maker, who had to resort to something like that.<NL>This time, we have Mister Tainted himself to prepare the array, and it will certainly not imprison you again for another thousands of years.<NL>You would do a lot of good for the world, and you would attain so much merits, Mister Immortal!"

a4450538-146f-43d2-9e56-2ad83998faa7/Opt.en: Mister Immortal... So you were indeed the pivot of the last Sword Mound Array...
a4450538-146f-43d2-9e56-2ad83998faa7/Opt.ru: Мистер Бессмертный... Итак, вы действительно были стержнем последнего массива Курганов мечей...

1fac7329-b0d9-4aed-a599-7fd3df958e9b/Eve.en: "True... They were... all just... scrap... metals..."<NL>Tainted muttered with his eyes closed...
1fac7329-b0d9-4aed-a599-7fd3df958e9b/Eve.ru: - Верно... Они были такими... все это просто... лом... металлов..."<NL>- пробормотал Испорченный с закрытыми глазами...

59f9a372-e4b9-47db-a964-701273d066fc/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was about to set out as usual to search for the next Sword Mound that was about to turn active,<NL>but unexpectedly, the Sword Mounds that were previously baring Mystic Sheens and strange murmurs<NL>suddenly lost their luster<NL>and fell silent at the same time...

a9a923ea-8c0e-42d1-9d85-f4bda977afc1/Eve.en: "... Right now, all sects are actively preparing for the Martial Arts Alliance Meeting.<NL>We hope that all heroes in the world may set aside their differences for now and contribute wealth and efforts together, endorsing the wise and talented.<NL>Together, let us find the finest hero worthy of leading all of us..."

15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Eve.en: "Yufu's temper might not be that good,<NL>so please do not harbor a grudge against her. Why don't you let me mediate between you and her..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao said softly, her voice as gentle as the oriole's song from the mist...
15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Eve.ru: - Характер у Юфу, возможно, не такой уж хороший,<NL>поэтому, пожалуйста, не держи на нее зла. Почему бы тебе не позволить мне быть посредником между тобой и ней..."<NL>Тихо сказала Цзы Усяо, ее голос был нежен, как песня иволги из тумана...

15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.en: Lady Yufu is daring and fierce, and perhaps maybe a bit too temperamental...
15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.ru: Леди Юфу дерзка и свирепа, и, возможно, даже чересчур темпераментна...

15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.en: Nothing hurts more than the temper's flame...
15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.ru: Ничто так не ранит, как вспыльчивость...

15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.en: I am but a mere mortal. There's no reason for me to harbor a grudge against an immortal, at all...
15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.ru: Я всего лишь простой смертный. У меня вообще нет причин таить обиду на Бессмертного...

15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.en: A rage of temper kills the miserable man. How poor... How pitiable... How saddening...
15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.ru: Вспышка гнева убивает несчастного человека. Как бедно... Как это прискорбно... Как печально...

15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.en: The mightier one has been decided. There's no need for any mediation...
15d2a8ae-e6d1-4990-baa9-018862f1c8fd/Opt.ru: Более могущественный из них уже определен. Нет необходимости ни в каком посредничестве...

f6a85144-78ad-4b87-bbab-a4e2d642f37d/Eve.en: Just as expected...<NL>The black dust landed on the ground and took form of a human in pure white clothes, named Tainted...
f6a85144-78ad-4b87-bbab-a4e2d642f37d/Eve.ru: Как и ожидалось...<NL>Черная пыль приземлилась на землю и приняла форму человека в белоснежной одежде по имени Испорченный...

d4953c29-e976-4e08-838f-ff711d398774/Eve.en: "Across ten lives, one man wrought ten divine swords.<NL>Each Extraordinary estranged with obsessions all their own.<NL>Swore to see divine edges ever hone,<NL>for if Xiangshu remained, the mortal realm would be doomed!<NL><NL>That's right! This sword is the first of the ten swords: the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>!"

d4953c29-e976-4e08-838f-ff711d398774/Opt.en: Swore to see divine edges ever hone... for if Xiangshu remained, the mortal realm would be doomed...
d4953c29-e976-4e08-838f-ff711d398774/Opt.ru: Поклялся, что увижу, как божественные грани когда-нибудь отточатся... ибо, если бы Сяншу остался, царство смертных было бы обречено...

326c3f06-890f-4193-a27a-8e8dcc4c855b/Eve.en: "O' what brings this fleeting night? For we drift upon the flowing stream. O' what brings this passing day? For we are faring on this boat together.<NL>I am grateful for your gracious fondness, despite my lowly status. My heart is endlessly troubled, for I got to know you.<NL>O' on hills flourish the trees, o' on trees flourish the branches, and o' my hearts find joy in you... and lo', this humble bamboo is contented..."<NL><NL>Zi Wuxiao chanted with her head down, remaining unmoved by Xiangshu...

a47b349c-38c1-41d0-847b-176bdddff79e/Eve.en: "All creatures are born to fall, as the heaven and earth are burned in turmoil.<NL>When the nascent world was first formed in creation's start, here arose I, the primeval fiend of all fiends!"<NL><NL>With a horrible roar, the land shattered and the world tumbled!<NL>Xiangshu had escaped...
a47b349c-38c1-41d0-847b-176bdddff79e/Eve.ru: "Все существа рождены, чтобы пасть, поскольку небо и земля сгорают в смятении.<NL>Когда зарождающийся мир был впервые сформирован в начале творения, здесь возник я, первобытный дьявол из всех демонов!"<NL><NL>С ужасным грохотом земля раскололась, и мир рухнул!<NL>Сяншу сбежал...

087e5884-60e9-49cc-a506-8eed3a53c91c/Eve.en: "Ha! You are blessed to be able to witness my true appearance.<NL>Why aren't you worshipping me right now, but instead moping around here..."<NL>Long Yufu laughed heartily upon hearing these words, flipping off the tiger's back and giving it a pat on the rump.<NL>The large white tiger immediately drooped its ears, then led the tigers back into the forest...

43bc813d-1aca-455a-85bc-307cfc135206/Eve.en: "You are but a mere mortal, yet you dare to walk among the fiends and immortals.<NL>No wonder that idiot Taoist was so fond of you, 'Taiwu.' You're really lovely in your idiotic way..."<NL>As Long Yufu spoke, the burning heat from her hands intensified, forcing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> to back off a few steps...

43bc813d-1aca-455a-85bc-307cfc135206/Opt.en: "No matter how you pressure me, this Sword Mound is sealed by the black mist. Not even wind can get in, so there is nothing I can do..."
43bc813d-1aca-455a-85bc-307cfc135206/Opt.ru: "Независимо от того, как ты давишь на меня, этот Курган мечей запечатан черным туманом. Даже ветер не может проникнуть внутрь, так что я ничего не могу сделать..."

cfd54b89-c61a-472f-87af-b36963992aef/Eve.en: In a place of vast open sky,<NL>Tainted swept aside the celestial dome and leaped upward.<NL>He let out a second snarl, and myriad of pure Qi answered the call and converged here!
cfd54b89-c61a-472f-87af-b36963992aef/Eve.ru: В месте бескрайнего открытого неба,<NL>Испорченный отбросил в сторону небесный купол и прыгнул вверх.<NL>Он издал второй рык, и мириады чистой Ци ответили на зов и собрались здесь!

e42793a2-ae0e-4da2-b025-8fe404f5eddd/Eve.en: "You Han people showed no respect to the fiends nor the immortals, yet now we Miao people had to pay the price too.<NL>My brothers and sisters all want to hear what you have to say!"<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> said gritting teeth, as they struggled to get up and forcibly steadied themselves...

a104e2f3-d029-4824-a002-bd21b983e880/Eve.en: Suddenly, Immortal Xu yelped loudly and lost control of his limbs!<NL>Six streams of blood gushed out from Immortal Xu's meridian orifices.<NL>Three flew to the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color>, and three flew straight to Xiangshu!
a104e2f3-d029-4824-a002-bd21b983e880/Eve.ru: Внезапно Бессмертный Сюй громко вскрикнул и потерял контроль над своими конечностями!<NL>Шесть струй крови хлынули из Меридианов Бессмертного Сюя.<NL>Трое полетели к <color=#yellow>Рукоять Фуюй</color>, и трое полетели прямиком в Сяншу!

5a22b740-5ddc-40f7-a700-624fda7094da/Eve.en: With resolve firmly set, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> hesitated no longer<NL>and gazed upon the nine rays of divine light conjured by Tainted, which neatly enclosed Taiwu Village within.<NL>They then looked over to the surrounding fifteen sealing arrays laid in wait, from which the ceaseless clamor of sects and fiends locked in fierce combat could be heard...

6bc88c8a-589d-4ee3-ac29-1bca5136b55d/Eve.en: At that moment, black flames raged across the sky!<NL>With barely a moment to catch their breath, the shattered mortal realm was plunged once more into endless, wicked black flames.<NL>Even Xiangshu was burned dry in the belly and his visage incinerated by black flames, exposing his charred fangs and fiendish bones...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and Huanxin both wielded the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> together, conjuring a cleansing light and slashing at the black flames.<NL>Yet, even after repeated attempts of reckless charges, they were still unable to break into the sea of black flames...

a0039311-c632-438d-9796-5aa9d4f1d2e3/Eve.en: "We, Veil Scar Sect, never pry into unnecessary matters.<NL>We just want to know... how can we slay that fiend, Xiangshu?"<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> said gritting teeth, as they struggled to get up and forcibly steadied themselves...
a0039311-c632-438d-9796-5aa9d4f1d2e3/Eve.ru: - Мы, Секта Завесы, никогда не вмешиваемся в ненужные дела.<NL>Мы просто хотим знать... как мы можем убить этого дьявола, Сяншу?"<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> сказал, стиснув зубы, когда они изо всех сил пытались встать и с усилием удерживали равновесие...

8800a75c-d29e-4215-b169-cf46f4879648/Eve.en: "Were it not for Huanxin sacrificing herself to clear the fiendish obstacles for you, how could I have found you...<NL>I dares not to take... such credit... Huanxin, she..."<NL>Immortal Xu said with his head low. Though his face was made of wood, grief and sorrow were still evident on it.<NL>For a moment, everyone was teary and even the world seemed to fall silent...

06b2162b-3214-433d-aa82-21262967e6c7/Eve.en: The light of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color> in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand faded away, and the sword turned to ashes in an instant!<NL>Huanxin nodded softly to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, and with a gentle smile, she dispersed into the wind...<NL><NL>Having missed the last chance to vanquish the fiend, Xiangshu could now roam free in the human world, raining atrocities everywhere.<NL>No longer would any land be peaceful in the world,<NL>for all its dwellers are either evils or viles...

06b2162b-3214-433d-aa82-21262967e6c7/Opt.en: Endless suffering spread throughout the world after the footsteps of Xiangshu! {0}
06b2162b-3214-433d-aa82-21262967e6c7/Opt.ru: Бесконечные страдания распространились по всему миру по стопам Сяншу! {0}

6a2f682c-c0b3-495b-b001-818cc7bffe3a/Eve.en: "Right or wrong, it was all but a dream. You're welcome to come here whenever you please..."<NL>Zi Wuxiao whispered quietly, and suddenly a bamboo forest materialized behind her. She then quietly took a seat under the bamboo...
6a2f682c-c0b3-495b-b001-818cc7bffe3a/Eve.ru: - Правильно это или нет, но все это было всего лишь сном. Вы можете приходить сюда, когда вам заблагорассудится..."<NL>- тихо прошептала Цзы Усяо, и внезапно позади нее материализовался бамбуковый лес. Затем она тихо присела под бамбуком...

6a2f682c-c0b3-495b-b001-818cc7bffe3a/Opt.en: ...You said that this was your deep dream, lady. So, could it be that all I saw before were also just dreams?!
6a2f682c-c0b3-495b-b001-818cc7bffe3a/Opt.ru: ..Вы сказали, что это была ваша сокровенная мечта, леди. Так, может быть, все, что я видел раньше, тоже было просто сном?!

a75c171f-31cb-47cd-9380-6ed529d811a8/Eve.en: "You... go and...<NL>reveal... the truth of here... for me..."<NL>Tainted said fearfully, and with a sudden swing of his hand, he sent <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> to the blossom sea with a breeze...
a75c171f-31cb-47cd-9380-6ed529d811a8/Eve.ru: "Ты... иди и...<NL>раскрой... правду о происходящем здесь... для меня..."<NL>- испуганно сказал Испорченный и резким взмахом руки отправил <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> к цветущему морю с легким ветерком...

40d491f3-b206-4dd6-be71-fc125a4233ae/Eve.en: Tainted smiled faintly and conjured his divine power.<NL>The nine divine swords' hilts flew back to his side from the ruins,<NL>orbiting and forming a whirling sword formation around him. Instantly, a gale swirled up around Tainted!<NL><NL>The gale pierced through the heavens and earth, rolling up all fiends, blood ashes, blackstones, and black flames,<NL>funneling them all together... into Tainted's chest!

1f6681d9-1230-4f7c-b25f-272625778edd/Eve.en: "Child. You retrieved a few divine swords, and so Tainted cast down a few divine lights correspondingly.<NL>Of course, this means you should re-conjure the sealing power and recreate the Sword Mound Array using the nine divine swords!<NL>Though this Nine Swords Array has only one extra sword than the old Eight Swords Array, its power would far exceed the old one, and that should be enough to keep the world safe for another thirty thousand years!"<NL>Immortal Xu stroked his beard and nodded as he spoke, but appeared rather fearful when he spoke of thirty thousand years...

8d8688cc-f761-47b8-b8f1-897e03e2838f/Eve.en: "Could it be... the end of the mortal world now?"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> stood between the crashing current of blackstones and blood ashes, murmuring and questioning...<NL><NL>Yet, in this boundless, endless darkness, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s heart was left with only emptiness.<NL>It was a question that arose from somewhere beyond words, and it was a question that no one could ever answer...

8d8688cc-f761-47b8-b8f1-897e03e2838f/Opt.ru: (Никто никогда не смог бы ответить на этот вопрос...)

7304a492-34e8-4828-a4ce-3cd680686737/Eve.en: Who could now wield such a genuine power?<NL>In a flash, the divine sword unveiled at long last!<NL>What a marvelous "Sword of Egolessness"!<NL>What an incredible <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes snapped open wide!<NL>The <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color> and the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword Edge</color> have at last been rejoined as one in grasp!<NL><NL>Huanxin stood now at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s side, clasping hands upon the sword, as together they direct its edge at the fiend!

ddaee642-4d88-4c10-8372-2c7d14f7d278/Eve.en: "It... is... what I used... to mourn...<NL>for my departed friend... at Mt. Chai... in the past..."<NL>Tainted paused for a long while here before continuing to explain:<NL>"Mortals... have fleeting and fragile lives. What you are doing now... are regarded as impossible... and it would surely lead to death of many others...<NL>I... pity you, so I would like to... gift this... to you to comfort you for your loss...<NL>This object... can recall... the dead and transport them... to reincarnation..."

ddaee642-4d88-4c10-8372-2c7d14f7d278/Opt.en: Recall the dead? Transport them to reincarnation?
ddaee642-4d88-4c10-8372-2c7d14f7d278/Opt.ru: Воскрешать мертвых? Перенести их в реинкарнацию?

950d1762-9740-426d-b857-02f9305f5ef2/Eve.en: "That's not bad, either!<NL>I will be the stubborn one, and you will be the obsessed one!"
950d1762-9740-426d-b857-02f9305f5ef2/Eve.ru: - Это тоже неплохо!<NL>Я буду упрямым, а ты будешь одержимым!"

9d9a02c3-cd77-4a03-aa87-1375450217b7/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> held the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color> and launched a desperate strike!<NL><NL>However, the fiend was too powerful...<NL>Even with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> exerting all his strength, the attack only barely slashed across Xiangshu's waist,<NL>inflicting only a small injury. Xiangshu didn't even look or notice it in the slightest!?<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s strength was depleted with that single attack,<NL>and immediately after, began falling from the high sky toward the ground below...

9d9a02c3-cd77-4a03-aa87-1375450217b7/Opt.en: It seems... this is... the end...
9d9a02c3-cd77-4a03-aa87-1375450217b7/Opt.ru: Кажется... это так и есть... конец...

3ae4acce-fb45-426e-8da3-ad95c6a14111/Eve.en: "You've descended into the realm for seven days and barely survived...<NL>I see inky darkness at your forehead. You must have lost much of your lifespan there..."<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=OrgName/>'s <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> sighed, eyes filled with blood vessels and sweat still damp on forehead...

3ae4acce-fb45-426e-8da3-ad95c6a14111/Opt.en: So... you all have been waiting here... for seven days...
3ae4acce-fb45-426e-8da3-ad95c6a14111/Opt.ru: Итак... вы все ждали здесь... в течение семи дней...

64daab5b-31f0-4a0c-a6b7-f6e3d2c9d623/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> thought over it carefully,<NL>taking stock of the resources and Silver brought along,<NL>and pondered what should be donated to assist <ArgBox key=SectName type=string/> in organizing the Martial World Tournament...
64daab5b-31f0-4a0c-a6b7-f6e3d2c9d623/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> тщательно обдумал это,<NL>проводим инвентаризацию привезенных с собой Ресурсов и серебра,<NL>и размышлял о том, что следует пожертвовать для оказания помощи <ArgBox key=SectName type=string/> в организации турнира "Мир боевых искусств "...

d2a36985-75be-4ec5-94fe-80d4b98b0fc2/Eve.en: Huanxin's Innate Soul slowly departed from her body,<NL>she could only say to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />: "You have... my heartfelt thanks..."<NL>before she fell to the ground with a faint smile...
d2a36985-75be-4ec5-94fe-80d4b98b0fc2/Eve.ru: Врожденная душа Хуаньсинь медленно покидала ее тело,<NL>она могла только сказать <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />: "Примите... мою сердечную благодарность..."<NL>прежде чем она упала на землю со слабой улыбкой...

ff027cf2-c431-4579-bee3-14b160826f62/Eve.en: "..."<NL>Tainted cast Long Yufu a deep look, and then cast Zi Wuxiao another deep look...<NL>Tainted had already taken in all black flames that lingered on Xiangshu's remains into his body...

Instantly, a gale swirled up around Tainted!<NL>The gale pierced through the heavens and earth, rolling up all fiends, blood ashes, blackstones, and black flames,<NL>funneling them all together... into Tainted's chest!
